name: clinical_v0_gate50_gate212_composed
rationale: Composed final-layer weights identify units 198 and 38 as positive readout paths that activate for high normalized values. In 128 calibration patients, their active cases remain underestimated after the original affine correction; almost all are measured variables rather than static/administrative channels. Increase only these two effective output coefficients by 1%, a fixed conservative expansion of the existing learned paths. Negative GELU-tail contributions change in the opposite direction, also consistent with the common positive offset in the low/middle range. No fitting, gradients, optimizer or test data. Exact median-draw activations of the edited model show unit 198 still underestimating in its positive intermediate range (median normalized errors -0.0128, -0.0327, -0.0492 in activation bins 0-0.5, 0.5-1, 1-2), across 93, 81, 96 calibration patients. Above 2 the median error reverses sign to +0.0223. Add a localized triangular correction in preactivation z198: k*(GELU(16*z)-4*GELU(16*(z-1.5))+3*GELU(16*(z-2)))/16, k=0.04*the current effective coefficient. It rises toward the strongest intermediate underestimation and switches off before the high tail. A single fixed 4% slope is used; no fitting or sweep. Reuse three existing neurons with negligible effective contributions. Unit 38 is unchanged because its remaining residual signs are inconsistent. The running benchmark candidate remains unchanged; no clinical test result informed this proposal. Compose the independent 1% sharpening of negative-only head unit 47, using its already specified weights unchanged. The local positive repair reduced mean confirmation MSE but cost MAE; unit 47 sharpening reduced MAE on both confirmation seeds but slightly cost MSE. They address intermediate underestimation and a common positive negative-tail contribution through disjoint neurons. No coefficient is refitted, searched or derived from test. Test their composition as a single new hypothesis, retaining it only if full forward evaluations support joint improvement. New calibration median-draw preactivations show unit 255 remains entirely negative. Its negative coefficient turns GELU's negative lobe into a positive output hump. For z in [-1.5,-1), residual median is +0.00673; for z in [-1,-0.5), it is -0.00197, each across 127 patients. Translate this hump by changing only incoming bias 255 by -0.01. This lowers its left-tail contribution and raises its contribution near zero, unlike uniform attenuation. The pattern is stronger on static/admin/time variables; physiological subgroup signs are mixed. This is one fixed hypothesis on an experimental parent, not a demonstrated causal correction. No gradients, training, parameter sweep or test residuals are used. V1 test scores have already been seen in the ongoing benchmark; any later test is a repeated benchmark assessment. The two positive head paths 38 and 198 have partly aligned incoming weights (cosine 0.69). Normally z38 is below z198. A positive contrast z38-z198 occurs in only 15 median-selected scoring entries across 11 of 512 calibration patients in the gate255 model; its median and mean normalized residuals are negative. Six cases overpredict, so the association is neither universal nor causal proof. An enriched target-free probe shows this contrast remains sparse at both noise steps. Reuse nearly disconnected units 181 and 150 to implement a small capped ramp: A*(GELU(64*d)-GELU(64*(d-1)))/64, d=z38-z198, A=0.05*effective_coefficient38. The zero threshold detects order reversal, the unit contrast caps the response, and the fixed 5% amplitude is not fitted to residual magnitudes. Sharpness confines the small negative GELU lobe near the threshold. No derivatives, training, optimizer, coefficient sweep or test targets are used. This is a new hypothesis requiring complete forward evaluations. A separate local hypothesis addresses positive learned path50, whose incoming weight direction has cosine-0.356 with path21. In the unchanged V4 calibration512 diagnostic, 761 median-selected scored entries across276 patients have z50 in[1,4). Mean and median normalized residuals are positive overall and in the physiological subgroup, with60.14% positive patient medians. Both coarse[1,2) and[2,4) bins have positive means and medians; several variables still underpredict. Below1 the positive region has a negative mean; above4 only one patient is represented. Reuse nearly disconnected units31,237,120 for A*(GELU(64*(z-1))-2*GELU(64*(z-2.5)) +GELU(64*(z-4)))/64, with A=-0.05*effective_coefficient50. The ideal triangular subtraction vanishes outside[1,4]; smoothing introduces small boundary lobes. The interval, its midpoint, sharpness64 and fixed5% weight fraction are declared before any candidate accuracy evaluation. This hypothesis uses calibration evidence recorded before V8 accuracy results. It is independent of V8 and starts fromV4; it reuses distinct quiet units and contains no V8 operations. No residual amplitude fitting, derivatives, optimizer, parameter sweep, training, confirmation or test residuals are used. Compose the unchanged V7 gate212 shoulder with V9. V7 is a child of V3; V9 contains the V4 relative-tail program and its own gate50 program. V7 and V9 each improved both metrics on calibration512 and on each of two full confirmation2016 seeds against their respective parents. V7's earlier confirmation128 result was mixed; the unchanged full-partition expansion is the declared selection evidence, not a retuned V7. Modified coordinates are disjoint and the readout is common. Final ideal supports overlap at54 entries on V9 calibration512, so additive accuracy is not assumed. Copy all three V7 delta operations exactly: no new amplitude, threshold, coefficient fit, gradient, optimizer, training or parameter sweep. First compare the complete composed forward against V9 and V7 on calibration512. If both metrics improve, advance unchanged to full confirmation2016 with both fixed seeds; do not select or retune from a smaller confirmation subset. Confirmation and benchmark are reused across hypotheses; no fresh-holdout claim.
